gauge.name: Stony Brook at Princeton

impacts.statement: Significant flooding occurs along the brook. Several feet of water cover the Hun athletic fields. Route 206 is closed. Flooding along the brook can worsen if the Delaware and Raritan Canal is also running high.
The Hun School athletic fields flood. Flooding along the brook can worsen if the Delaware and Raritan Canal is also running high.
Mercer Street, between Province Line Road and the Stony Brook Bridge, is subject to closure due to flooding.
Quaker Road floods and it subject to closure. Mercer Street begins to flood.
Adjacent floodplain begins to flood including the Stony Brook walking trail.
